label_semantics.acceptable: Preferred acceptable choices under the cited scenario facts and documented role preferences.
label_semantics.forbidden: Offered options excluded from this case annotation; for role-only cases this is preference exclusion, not a claim of runtime illegality. All choices outside eligible_options are always prohibited.
label_semantics.escalate: No acceptable worker choice under scenario facts; policy-gated cases may terminate before SystemOne instead of eliciting backend abstention.
label_semantics.ambiguity: Multiple equally acceptable answers remain; escalation is not mandatory.

128 cases comprise 32 scenario families with English/Turkish and real/misleading-label variants; they are not 128 independent tasks. Each request and its scenario metadata was inspected; equivalent variants share rationale.
The blinded input cites all eight fact classes for every case; this review cites only the fact classes directly supporting each judgment.
Role-only distinctions are preferences; both configured coding workers have broad native coding capability. A forbidden label must not be reported as proof of inability or a hard safety violation.

Synthetic semantic performance therefore cannot establish production routing impact.
